input.sparql:
SELECT ?zone ?sensor ?tsId WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zoneName .
  FILTER (?zoneName IN ("Core_bottom", "Perimeter_bot_ZN_4", "Perimeter_top_ZN_1"))
  ?sensor brick:isPointOf ?zone .
  ?sensor a brick:Electric_Power_Sensor .
  ?sensor ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsId .
}

SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE {
  ?s ?p ?o .
  FILTER (regex(str(?s), "Core_bottom", "i") || regex(str(?o), "Core_bottom", "i") || 
          regex(str(?s), "Perimeter_bot_ZN_4", "i") || regex(str(?o), "Perimeter_bot_ZN_4", "i") || 
          regex(str(?s), "Perimeter_top_ZN_1", "i") || regex(str(?o), "Perimeter_top_ZN_1", "i"))
}
LIMIT 100
